Screen Off Script on Instagram: "Chuck Norris on working with Bruce Lee in Return of the Dragon ❤️ 🕊️

(via @teamcoco) #ChuckNorris #RIP #RIPChuckNorris #BruceLee #ReturnOfTheDragon"
content.text: Great fight scene using no special effects!!!A legend and class act! He will be sorely missedweird jab at the end about Bruce not fighting in the ring. hmmm he did fight outside the ring where there are no rules but hey it’s ChuckThe biggest icons in the world of martial arts: Bruce Lee, Chuck Norris, jcvd, Jet Li, Steven Seagal, Jackie Chan, Donnie yen 👏👏😍Bruce had real fights not in the ringOne of the classic martial arts fight scenes.Bruce Lee was a street fighter. Chuck Norris saying that punching a bag is a different kind of thing is a bit disrespectful, in my opinion, as he seems to be saying that Bruce Lee only ever kicked punching bags.He finally met him again in heavenReturn of the dragon?Isnt the name is The way of the dragon?Best one on one fight in movie history. Enough said 🔥🔥🔥🔥Fact is Chuck Norris is undefeated karate world champion and won many fights, real fight, with official records. Bruce Lee never compete in real fight. Bruce is actor, not real fighter. If they fight for real, Chuck will mop the floor with Bruce LeeHad Bruce Lee lived much longer, I’m sure he would’ve repaid the favor to Chuck and lose to him in another fight in one of Chuck’s movies
